verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents a Realtime transcription WebSocket API reference with a concrete endpoint (wss://global.rt.speechmatics.com/v2/) that routes to the nearest region for low latency. The docs also describe converting streaming audio to text instantly, recommend temporary keys for realtime clients, and expose configuration options such as custom dictionary and domain models. Missing for 10: details of the real-time result message format (partial vs. final transcripts) are not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream live audio over a documented WebSocket or streaming endpoint and receive transcription in real time

citations.quote: connect to wss://global.rt.speechmatics.com/v2/, which automatically routes each connection to the nearest region for lowest latency
Instantly convert streaming audio to text with Realtime processing
temporary keys should be used to avoid exposing your long-lived API key.
